verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.176
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.176

verses.pali: 18. Upāsakavagga
verses.english: 18. A Lay Follower

verses.pali: Pītisutta
verses.english: Rapture

verses.pali: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṁ gahapatiṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the householder Anāthapiṇḍika, escorted by around five hundred lay followers, went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to him:

verses.pali: “Tumhe kho, gahapati, bhikkhusaṅghaṁ paccupaṭṭhitā cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena.
verses.english: “Householders, you have supplied the mendicant Saṅgha with robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Na kho, gahapati, tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhi karaṇīyā:
verses.english: But you should not be content with just this much.

verses.pali: ‘mayaṁ bhikkhusaṅghaṁ paccupaṭṭhitā cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārenā’ti.
Tasmātiha, gahapati, evaṁ sikkhitabbaṁ:
verses.english: So you should train like this:

verses.pali: ‘kinti mayaṁ kālena kālaṁ pavivekaṁ pītiṁ upasampajja vihareyyāmā’ti.
verses.english: ‘How can we, from time to time, enter and dwell in the rapture of seclusion?’

verses.pali: Evañhi vo, gahapati, sikkhitabban”ti.
verses.english: That’s how you should train.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he said this, Venerable Sāriputta said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: “acchariyaṁ, bhante, abbhutaṁ, bhante.
verses.english: “It’s incredible, sir, it’s amazing!

verses.pali: Yāva subhāsitañcidaṁ, bhante, bhagavatā:
verses.english: How well said this was by the Buddha:

verses.pali: ‘tumhe kho, gahapati, bhikkhusaṅghaṁ paccupaṭṭhitā cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena.
verses.english: ‘Householders, you have supplied the mendicant Saṅgha with robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.

verses.pali: Na kho, gahapati, tāvatakeneva tuṭṭhi karaṇīyā—
verses.english: But you should not be content with just this much.

verses.pali: mayaṁ bhikkhusaṅghaṁ paccupaṭṭhitā cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānappaccayabhesajjaparikkhārenāti.
Tasmātiha, gahapati, evaṁ sikkhitabbaṁ—
verses.english: So you should train like this:

verses.pali: kinti mayaṁ kālena kālaṁ pavivekaṁ pītiṁ upasampajja vihareyyāmāti.
verses.english: “How can we, from time to time, enter and dwell in the rapture of seclusion?”

verses.pali: Evañhi vo, gahapati, sikkhitabban’ti.
verses.english: That’s how you should train.’

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhante, samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṁ pītiṁ upasampajja viharati, pañcassa ṭhānāni tasmiṁ samaye na honti.
verses.english: At a time when a noble disciple enters and dwells in the rapture of seclusion, five things aren’t present in him.

verses.pali: Yampissa kāmūpasaṁhitaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ, tampissa tasmiṁ samaye na hoti.
verses.english: The pain and sadness connected with sensual pleasures.

verses.pali: Yampissa kāmūpasaṁhitaṁ sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, tampissa tasmiṁ samaye na hoti.
verses.english: The pleasure and happiness connected with sensual pleasures.

verses.pali: Yampissa akusalūpasaṁhitaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ, tampissa tasmiṁ samaye na hoti.
verses.english: The pain and sadness connected with the unskillful.

verses.pali: Yampissa akusalūpasaṁhitaṁ sukhaṁ somanassaṁ, tampissa tasmiṁ samaye na hoti.
verses.english: The pleasure and happiness connected with the unskillful.

verses.pali: Yampissa kusalūpasaṁhitaṁ dukkhaṁ domanassaṁ, tampissa tasmiṁ samaye na hoti.
verses.english: The pain and sadness connected with the skillful.

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhante, samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṁ pītiṁ upasampajja viharati, imānissa pañca ṭhānāni tasmiṁ samaye na hontī”ti.
verses.english: At a time when a noble disciple enters and dwells in the rapture of seclusion, these five things aren’t present in him.”

verses.pali: “Sādhu sādhu, sāriputta.
verses.english: “Good, good, Sāriputta!

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
